source_review.target_clause: NRS 484B.413(2): continuous indication over the last 300 feet in any other area before changing course, regardless of weather.
source_review.separate_clause: The same subsection uses 100 feet in a business or residential district; the six selected cases do not test that district branch.
source_review.applicability_limit: Authored any-other-area label is a request; Native land use, frontage, road status, actual indication and course-change onset require original evidence.
source_review.hill_crest_limit: C104393 hill crest and other vehicle are cell context, not a substitute for the statutory distance or district evidence.
